symulator_rankingu_publikacji.title: Master's Thesis - Scientific Publication Ranking Simulator
symulator_rankingu_publikacji.description:
A project developed as part of a Master's thesis at Poznan University of Technology, featuring an experimental system that simulates a scientific search engine to analyze the impact of ranking algorithms on publication visibility.

The project involved:
• Applying logarithmic data transformation to reduce the impact of extreme values, enabling accurate analysis of citation distributions.
• Implementing semantic search (vector database & NLP embeddings) to evaluate the similarity between queries and documents.
• Optimizing experiment performance.
• Conducting statistical analysis (power law, Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests) and comparing simulation results with real-world data (DBLP).
